definition: Playful early-2000s styling built around shine, compact silhouettes, low-rise references and intentionally youthful pop details.
styling_rules: Keep the base playful but not overloaded.
Use one nostalgic focal point and modernize the rest.
Balance short silhouettes with cleaner accessories.
Prefer glossy or metallic accents over full costume styling.
avoid: Avoid stacking every 2000s cue at maximum intensity.
Do not combine low-rise, rhinestones, metallic boots and slogan graphics all at once for a casual setting.

casual: Use a fitted tee, straight denim and one nostalgic accent.
park: Keep footwear practical and reduce shine.
date: Use satin or a sleek mini bag as the focal point.
theatre: Choose a polished slip silhouette instead of novelty pieces.

definition: Bold dark-feminine glamour built on confidence, rich textures, sharp accessories and a controlled statement attitude.
styling_rules: Use one dominant statement element.
Keep the base sleek when outerwear is dramatic.
Prefer structured shoes and bag shapes.
Gold details should accent rather than overwhelm.
avoid: Avoid combining faux fur, animal print, bright bodycon and heavy jewelry at full strength.
Do not let the outfit turn into costume glamour for low-key occasions.

casual: Use a fitted knit, dark straight trousers and one luxe accent.
park: Tone down drama and keep the statement to outerwear or bag only.
date: Use a sleek dress or fitted base with one rich texture.
theatre: A polished coat, pointed shoes and restrained gold accents work best.

definition: Soft romantic femininity centered on bows, delicate trims, light palettes and intentionally sweet styling.
styling_rules: Use softness selectively and keep the silhouette intentional.
Repeat delicate detail in two places at most.
Mix lace or ribbons with cleaner base pieces.
Prefer light contrast over sugary overload.
avoid: Avoid making every item frilly at once.
Do not pair bows, lace socks, satin mini dress and pearl overload for casual daytime use.

casual: Use a cardigan, straight skirt or jeans and one bow detail.
park: Keep footwear simple and lower the amount of trim.
date: Lace or satin can be the hero, but not every piece.
theatre: Choose a refined midi silhouette with restrained sweetness.

definition: Sharp sensual tailoring with fitted knits, pencil shapes, sleek glasses and an intentionally polished corporate edge.
styling_rules: Keep the line clean and fitted rather than overly revealing.
Structured accessories sharpen the look.
Use one sensual note and keep everything else polished.
Stay within a corporate palette for credibility.
avoid: Avoid overt clubwear styling under the office_siren label.
Do not mix extreme bodycon, transparent fabric and overly casual shoes.

casual: Swap heels for sleek flats and keep the fitted base.
park: Lower formality with knitwear and a longer hemline.
date: Use a pencil or column silhouette with refined accessories.
theatre: A sharp blazer and elegant pumps create a polished version.

definition: Intellectual vintage-inspired dressing built around dark neutrals, tweed, wool, loafers and literary restraint.
styling_rules: Layer textures instead of adding random detail.
Prefer scholarly structure and muted color contrast.
Use vintage references with clean proportions.
Shoes should ground the outfit in polish.
avoid: Avoid turning the look into a literal costume uniform.
Do not stack cape, tie, beret and plaid at once without simplification.

casual: Use one textured layer over a simple knit base.
park: Keep shoes practical and limit heavy layering.
date: A soft knit with structured outerwear feels intentional.
theatre: Lean into richer wool, velvet or polished leather accents.

definition: Refined understated elegance focused on quality, restraint, smooth tailoring and expensive-looking simplicity.
styling_rules: Keep the palette controlled and clean.
Choose polish over obvious branding.
Let tailoring and fabric quality lead.
Avoid too many trends in one look.
avoid: Avoid flashy logos and novelty hardware.
Do not combine loud trend accents with the quiet-luxury base.

casual: Use polished knitwear and clean trousers.
park: Choose soft luxury basics and comfortable loafers or sneakers.
date: A restrained column or trouser look reads expensive and modern.
theatre: Refined tailoring and elegant outerwear suit the setting.

definition: Dark dramatic styling centered on black palettes, pointed shapes, rich texture contrast and a moody romantic edge.
styling_rules: Use texture contrast to keep black outfits dimensional.
Anchor dramatic pieces with clean silhouettes.
Pointed or structured shoes prevent the look from collapsing into softness.
Treat silver hardware as punctuation.
avoid: Avoid costume-shop layering and too many symbolic details.
Do not combine every dramatic cue unless the user explicitly wants a theatrical look.

casual: Keep the palette dark but simplify line and hardware.
park: Use comfortable boots and a cleaner base layer.
date: Lace or velvet can be the romantic focal point.
theatre: A richer texture mix and longer silhouette feel appropriate.

definition: A softened goth blend that keeps the dark palette and mood but filters it through lace, bows, delicate silhouettes and feminine polish.
styling_rules: Blend dark mood with softness instead of choosing one extreme.
Use lace or ribbon details with a grounded shoe.
Keep at least one structured or heavy element so the look does not become generic romantic.
Limit the number of overtly dramatic pieces.
avoid: Avoid making the outfit either too sugary or too costume-goth.
Do not combine lace, corsetry, heavy platform boots and dramatic makeup signals at maximum strength for everyday wear.

casual: Use a dark base with one romantic texture.
park: Keep the silhouette comfortable and use lighter detailing.
date: Lace and a deep palette work well when balanced with cleaner shoes.
theatre: A long skirt, velvet or lace and polished accessories suit the mood.

definition: Minimal polished everyday dressing built around neutral palettes, smooth layers and quietly athletic grooming energy.
styling_rules: Keep the palette tight and clean.
Use smooth textures and simple lines.
One polished accessory is enough.
Do not overload the look with trend detail.
avoid: Avoid piling on random sporty and romantic cues together.
Do not let minimal become bland through poor proportion.

casual: This style already suits casual use with polished basics.
park: Lean into clean sneakers and easy layers.
date: Add a smoother silhouette or refined bag.
theatre: Elevate with cleaner tailoring and dressier shoes.

definition: Graceful delicate styling inspired by dancewear, soft layers, wrap shapes and light-footed feminine balance.
styling_rules: Keep the line fluid and controlled.
Use soft footwear or ribbon detail as an accent, not a costume.
Balance fitted tops with softer lower volume.
Stay light-handed with sweetness.
avoid: Avoid turning the look into rehearsal costume styling.
Do not combine tulle, legwarmers, wrap top and bows all at once for everyday errands.

casual: Use soft knitwear and one ballet reference.
park: Prefer grounded flats or clean sneakers with a soft top.
date: A wrap silhouette and gentle texture read romantic without excess.
theatre: A more refined soft skirt and elegant flats feel coherent.
